bom_changes_line_kinds.name: bom_changes_line_kinds
bom_changes_line_kinds.value: ("bom_changes"."kind" in ('LINE_ADD', 'LINE_DEL', 'LINE_EDIT')) = ("bom_changes"."child_item_id" is not null and "bom_changes"."line_no" is not null)

partners_foreign_biz_no_length.name: partners_foreign_biz_no_length
partners_foreign_biz_no_length.value: "partners"."foreign_biz_no" is null or char_length("partners"."foreign_biz_no") between 1 and 30

partners_biz_no_by_country.name: partners_biz_no_by_country
partners_biz_no_by_country.value: ("partners"."country" = 'KR' and "partners"."foreign_biz_no" is null) or ("partners"."country" <> 'KR' and "partners"."biz_no" is null)

sales_plan_changes_some.name: sales_plan_changes_some
sales_plan_changes_some.value: "sales_plan_changes"."before" is not null or "sales_plan_changes"."after" is not null

stock_move_lines_warehouse_required.name: stock_move_lines_warehouse_required
stock_move_lines_warehouse_required.value: "stock_move_lines"."from_warehouse_id" is not null or "stock_move_lines"."to_warehouse_id" is not null
